entries.german: Kaiser Mathias bekundet, dass er dem Wolfgang, dem Wolf Friedrich, dem Eberhard, dem Hans Georg und dem Wolf Dietrich Kämmerer v. Worms gen. v. Dalberg das Blutgericht zu Essingen, wie die Familie v. Dalberg es von Hans Christoph v. Rosenberg erworben hatte, zu einem Reichslehen verliehen habe
entries.english: Emperor Mathias declares that he has enfeoffed Wolfgang, Wolf Friedrich, Eberhard, Hans Georg, and Wolf Dietrich Kämmerer von Worms called von Dalberg with the blood court of Essingen as an imperial fief, as the von Dalberg family had acquired it from Hans Christoph von Rosenberg

facts.content: had held the Blutgericht at Essingen before the Kämmerer von Worms genannt von Dalberg family acquired it from him.
